provenance: Original synthetic benchmark material; no real-world claims.

documents.title: Survey
documents.content: Among 200 respondents to an optional online survey, 72% supported later hours. Total registered members: 18,000. No nonresponse adjustment was made.

documents.title: Single-branch pilot
documents.content: A downtown branch opened until 10pm for four weeks. Evening visits rose 28%; 60% of those visits occurred before 8pm. No control branch was measured.

documents.title: Operating constraints
documents.content: Midnight staffing at all six branches would cost 180,000 credits per quarter. The approved additional staffing budget is 70,000 credits. Security coverage is contracted only until 10pm.

documents.title: Available decisions
documents.content: The board may extend the downtown 10pm pilot within 50,000 credits, commission a representative survey, or approve the full midnight rollout only after funding and security are secured.

documents.title: Claims to evaluate
documents.content: {"budget-gap": "The stated rollout staffing cost exceeds the approved additional budget.", "downtown-observation": "The downtown pilot recorded an increase in evening visits.", "funded-rollout": "The full rollout fits the approved extra staffing budget.", "universal-demand": "The survey proves that all registered members want midnight opening."}
